description: Cenarion Battlegear: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As you complete the tasks you're assigned in the war you'll want to talk to Vargus, the blacksmith. Show him any badges you've earned along the way. He'll provide you with gear to match your level of commitment to our cause.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Kaldon sent you? Very well, let's see what we can do for you.
